Dopamine antagonists (eg, neuroleptics, metoclopramide) may reduce ropinirole's efficacy and may diminish pramipexole's. Ropinirole is metabolized by CYP1A2: ciprofloxacin raises its levels and smoking is expected to increase its clearance; adjust the dose when a potent CYP1A2 inducer or inhibitor is started or stopped.
